## `global-roles list`

Retrieves the list of Global Roles with pagination, sorting and filtering.

```
epm-cli global-roles list [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/GlobalRoles` · Response: `GlobalRoleModelPagedResponse`

**Filters and parameters**

| Flag | Type | Values | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--sort FIELD[:asc\|desc]` | repeatable | | sort order, e.g. `--sort created:desc` |
| `--page-size` | integer |  | The number of records per page, for example 1. Shouldn't exceed 200. |
| `--page` | integer |  | The page number to retrieve from results, for example 1 |
| `--id` | UUID |  | Unique Identifier |
| `--name` | string |  | Name |
| `--description` | string |  | Description |
| `--is-built-in` | switch |  | true = Built-in. false = Custom. When the value is not provided the filter is not applied. |
| `--all`, `-A` | switch | | fetch every page |
| `--max-pages` | integer | | with `--all`: stop after N pages |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli global-roles list --all -o json
```

## `global-roles get`

Retrieves the details of a global role.

```
epm-cli global-roles get <ID> [flags]
```

API: `GET /v3/GlobalRoles/{id}` · Response: `GlobalRoleDetailModel`

**Arguments**

| Argument | Description |
|---|---|
| `<ID>` | id |

**Example**

```sh
epm-cli global-roles get <ID>
```
